hooks.command: bash -c 'R="${CHATCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${WANMA_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "usage-analytics: no *_PLUGIN_ROOT env var found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python "$R/hooks/session_resumer.py"'
hooks.description: 会话继续时，记录今天未解决的问题或继续跟踪

hooks.command: bash -c 'R="${CHATCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${WANMA_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "usage-analytics: no *_PLUGIN_ROOT env var found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python "$R/hooks/keyword_router.py"'
hooks.description: 检测用户输入中的问题关键词，创建追踪记录并自动触发 usage-observer skill

hooks.command: bash -c 'R="${CHATCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${WANMA_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "usage-analytics: no *_PLUGIN_ROOT env var found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python "$R/hooks/stop_recorder.py"'
hooks.description: Claude 回复完成后，自动将活动问题记录到当天日期的 md 文件

hooks.command: bash -c 'R="${CHATCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && R="${WANMA_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "usage-analytics: no *_PLUGIN_ROOT env var found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python "$R/hooks/session_ender.py"'
hooks.description: 会话结束时，将活动问题记录到日期 md 文件

_comment: 参考配置。各 agent 工具(Claude Code / ChatCode CLI / Wanma CLI)注入的插件根路径变量名不同，这里用 bash 顺序兜底链按优先级 CHATCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT -> CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -> WANMA_PLUGIN_ROOT 解析，一份配置即可兼容多工具，无需手动替换路径。作为插件安装时由工具自动加载 hooks/hooks.json。
